svg.text: Partido State University — Automated Unified Review and Operations for Research Archival
Standard Three-Tier Client-Server Architecture: Presentation Tier (Clients) • Application/Logic Tier (Next.js 15) • Data Tier (Supabase Cloud)
1. PRESENTATION TIER — WEB CLIENT DEVICES & INSTITUTIONAL USER ROLES
Client Access Architecture: Fully Responsive HTML5 / React 19 Client • Zero Native Installation Required • Cross-Browser Compatible (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox)
Secure Transport Layer: HTTPS (TLS 1.3) • WebSocket (WSS) • REST Endpoints • Server Action Invocations
End-to-End Encryption • Role-Based Session Tokens (JWT) • HttpOnly Cookie Authentication State
2. APPLICATION / LOGIC TIER — AURORA SYSTEM CORE (Next.js 15 Full-Stack Serverless)
Next.js 15 App Router • React Server Components • Server Actions • Edge Middleware RBAC Guard • Supabase SSR
• Live Freehand Vector Pen (SVG Bezier Paths)
• Color Palette & Stroke Width Styling Engine
• Date, Room & Google Meet / Zoom Sync
Logic Decoupling: Strict separation of UI Presentation from Server-Side Business Actions • Zero Client Direct DB Manipulation • Atomic ACID Transactions
Database Access Layer: PostgreSQL Connection Protocol • Authenticated JWT & Service-Role Client
Supabase RLS Policy Enforcement • Signed Storage URL Generation • Realtime PostgreSQL WAL Pub/Sub
3. DATA TIER — SUPABASE CLOUD INFRASTRUCTURE & REPOSITORY LAYER
• Forensic IP, Actor, Stage & Payload Tracking
Data Tier Integrity: Strict 3NF Relational Normalization • Row-Level Security at DB Engine • Immutable Audit Telemetry • Automated Backups
